key_insight: The paper investigates calcium–magnesium–aluminosilicate (CMAS) degradation of high-entropy zirconate thermal barrier coatings deposited by axial suspension plasma spray.
engineering_relevance: Understanding CMAS attack can guide coating selection for hot-section components exposed to molten mineral deposits.
evidence_signal: The supplied abstract provides indexing information only, with no experimental conditions, measurements, or performance results.
watch_item: CMAS resistance and service suitability cannot be assessed without the coating composition, exposure conditions, and degradation results.
paper_title: CMAS Degradation in High-Entropy Zirconate Thermal Barrier Coatings Deposited by Axial Suspension Plasma Spray
